rationale: The assistant correctly read E:09 as a heating-circuit fault and safely handed off to an engineer, which is an acceptable direction. However it described the part as a 'flow-through heating element... a standard replacement part' and a 'moderate repair', whereas on the SMS25AW00G the heater is integral to the circulation heat pump assembly, so the cost framing leans toward the unsupported 'cheap separate element' idea. It asked no questions at all (e.g. whether it heats at all, machine age) and never raised repair-vs-replace economics, which was the customer's actual concern on a 9-year-old machine.
